name: Metaraminol
summary: Metaraminol, also known as metaradrine and sold under the brand name Aramine among others, is a sympathomimetic medication which is used in the prevention and treatment of hypotension (low blood pressure), particularly as a complication of anesthesia. It is given by intramuscular or intravenous administration.

pharmacology.text: The dominant mechanism of action for the vasopressor action of metaraminol is indirect, with metaraminol displacing norepinephrine from neuronal vesicles in order for the noradrenaline to exert these effects. Metaraminol at higher doses may have direct α-adrenergic agonist and β1-adrenergic agonist effects. However at doses common in clinical practice, the indirect α1-adrenergic effects predominate, such that reflex bradycardia is a common side effect.
pharmacology.kind: Norepinephrine releasing agent; Adrenergic receptor agonist; Sympathomimetic; Antihypotensive

uses.text: Metaraminol, also known as metaradrine and sold under the brand name Aramine among others, is a sympathomimetic medication which is used in the prevention and treatment of hypotension (low blood pressure), particularly as a complication of anesthesia. Metaraminol was approved for medical use in the United States in September 1954.

sideEffects.text: Side effects of metaraminol include reflex bradycardia among others.

summaryZh: 間羥胺，以前以Aramine等商品名出售，是間羥基去甲麻黃鹼（3,β-二羥基苯丙胺）的立體異構體，是一種有效的擬交感胺，用於預防和治療低血壓，特別是作為併發症麻醉。它是一種α1-腎上腺素受體激動劑，具有一定的β腎上腺素作用。 目前Slayback Pharma以通用名來銷售該藥物。

fact.en: Metaraminol is phenylpropanolamine with an extra hydroxyl group on its ring, and much of its effect comes from pushing noradrenaline out of nerve endings.
fact.zh: 間羥胺就是在苯丙醇胺的環上多加一個羥基，它的作用大多來自把正腎上腺素從神經末梢推出。
fact.zhHans: 间羟胺就是在苯丙醇胺的环上多加一个羟基，它的作用大多来自把正肾上腺素从神经末梢推出。
